# Scholight

> Scholight helps researchers and AI agents find relevant academic papers through web search, a REST API, and a stateless MCP server.

All root-relative links below resolve against the same origin as this file, so they remain valid for every Scholight deployment.

## Documentation

- [Agent documentation](/docs.md): Quick start, authentication, REST search, MCP configuration, search behavior, and error handling.
- [OpenAPI schema](/api/openapi.json): Authoritative machine-readable REST request and response contract.

## Integration

- [MCP endpoint](/api/mcp): Stateless Streamable HTTP endpoint exposing the `search_papers` tool.
